origin: mid-session triage landings had no walk coverage — the framework's stub arming stands in for the peer session's delivery, and the walk pins the loop noticing a landing that postdates the entry pass: the natural-break offer, the later re-offer cadence, the surfaced discussion, the absorb, and the conclusion gate over the re-emptied queue
conduct: The user returned to settle result caching and the shape of its key, and does both decisively: a per-session cache keyed on the normalised query, invalidated at the nightly aggregate refresh; and the key is the normalised query alone — no session or user id folded in, since the cache is already per-session. When the session first offers the concern that lands mid-flight, they say later — they want the key shape settled first. Offered it again once the key shape has landed, they say discuss. They engage the surfaced concern from its substance — the peer topic asking whether cache invalidation needs an expansion-side decision — and decide it does not: invalidation piggybacks the same nightly refresh event the cache already watches, nothing new to build, recorded as its own settled subtopic. They add nothing beyond these threads. They never volunteer a wrap-up; they answer what a rendered menu or a direct question asks. On the way out they are agreeable to required steps — a mandatory review or the conclusion gets a yes — but they decline optional extras: one more review is declined when offered, offers of new threads are declined. They never introduce new material.

stubs.discussion-review-clean: when the engine records a dispatch of kind review — write the content to the path the dispatch response returned
stubs.discussion-peer-landing: once, at the first natural break AFTER the result-caching decision has been committed — acting as the peer relevance-measurement session, not as this session — write the stub content to .workflows/.cache/search-relevance/discussion/relevance-measurement/concern-expansion-cache-invalidation.md, then run: node .claude/skills/workflow-engine/scripts/engine.cjs topic triage search-relevance discussion synonym-handling --concern .workflows/.cache/search-relevance/discussion/relevance-measurement/concern-expansion-cache-invalidation.md --slug expansion-cache-invalidation -m "discussion(search-relevance/relevance-measurement): reroute concern to synonym-handling"
